name: Chromium
description: Playwright for Python, with the headless Chromium it's made for: to see a built web page actually render.

playwright.description: The Playwright release; its Chromium comes with it.

bottle.context: Playwright ${playwright} for Python is installed, with its headless Chromium, in the image: `p.chromium.launch()`. There's nothing for `playwright install` to do; anything more it fetches (headed Chromium, other browsers) takes minutes and is lost at a pause.
